notes.title: A Freezing Winter Update and a new Asia Cup!
notes.notes:
Get ready to face the snow in a new update that challenges you with a tournament against teams you never imagined, to win a cup that will leave you frozen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651035/f087b079b2f534c446ec570b947131050b1e3f21.png[/img]

The Asian Cup is just around the corner, and Charrua Soccer is joining the celebration! We have added this new cup to our arsenal of available tournaments. You can get ahead and start playing the Asian Cup 2023-2024 now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651035/8a1c21c22daefab5af69a188673a87028565d80a.png[/img]

We have also added Traditional Chinese to our list of supported languages, aligning with the new tournament! :)

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2726240]CHARRUA SOCCER - Mirror Edition![/url][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2726240

We've been thinking about how to improve access to Mirror Online and decided to make it free-to-play for everyone!

We hope this change will allow the game to gain a larger fan base, improving matchmaking and making it accessible for everyone to enjoy. Those who already own or plan to purchase the Pro Edition will also benefit from accessing their thematic items, stadiums, balls, etc., in Mirror Edition as well.

Don't forget to Add to Wishlist and to click Follow to be the first to know!


Finally, we have fixed several minor bugs, as well as various language issues that were reported to us (we apologize for the localization errors; as an indie studio, it's very hard to detect these things without your support).

That's all for now! We will continue working :)
Thank you for your support!
